subject: NexaHealth hosted-inference integration briefing — calendar coordination and prework
messages:
From: Maya Roberts <maya.roberts@nexahealth.com>
To: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
Cc: NexaHealth Integrations <integrations@nexahealth.com>
Date: Mon, 13 Sep 2026 09:15:00 -0700
Subject: Hosted inference architecture deep-dive — request to schedule

Hi Karthik / Marissa,

Thanks again for the demo last week — our engineering leads wanted to follow up with a short architecture deep-dive focused on the hosted API integration. Key topics we want to cover: SDK usage and migration patterns, streaming behavior for long responses, and implementing tool/function calling safely behind our proxy.

Can we schedule a 60-minute technical session next week? Our preferred times (PDT):
- Tue 9/14 10:00–11:00
- Wed 9/15 13:00–14:00

I've attached a quick spreadsheet with our baseline traffic profile and a short list of questions (nexa-prelim-reqs.xlsx). Also happy to share a Postman collection if that's helpful.

Best,
Maya Roberts
Senior Engineering Manager, Integrations
NexaHealth

Attachments: nexa-prelim-reqs.xlsx (spreadsheet/xlsx)
From: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>
To: Maya Roberts <maya.roberts@nexahealth.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>, Soojin Lee <soojin_lee@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 13 Sep 2026 11:02:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Hosted inference architecture deep-dive — request to schedule

Hi Maya — thanks for sending this over and for the clear scope. We can definitely cover SDK migration, streaming best practices, and the recommended approach for tool/function calling with hosted endpoints.

Proposed agenda (attached as redwood-hosted-arch-agenda-v1.pdf):
- 5m: intros & objectives
- 15m: Nexa requirements review (you)
- 25m: Redwood integration patterns (SDKs, streaming, caching, auth)
- 10m: Tool/function calling & safety model
- 5m: next steps & action items

I can do Tue 9/14 at 10:00 PDT or Wed 9/15 at 13:00 PDT — either works for our engineers. If neither is good, send a few slots and we'll accommodate.

Quick ask before the call: can you share one example prompt/flow that uses a tool or external API so we can prepare a short live demo (no real PHI, just simulated traffic)? If sharing is sensitive, a pseudo-example is fine. Also, please confirm whether your traffic will come through a customer-side proxy or direct from Redwood (helps us cover network/egress in the discussion).

I've attached the draft agenda and a Postman collection stub we sometimes use (postman-collection-nexa-hosted.json).

Thanks,
Karthik Iyer
Solutions Architect | Redwood Inference
karthik_iyer@redwood.com

Attachments: redwood-hosted-arch-agenda-v1.pdf (application/pdf), postman-collection-nexa-hosted.json (application/json)
From: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>

Date: Mon, 13 Sep 2026 12:35:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Hosted inference architecture deep-dive — request to schedule

Maya — looping in Soojin from our runtime team for the streaming and KV-cache discussion.

We can confirm Tue 9/14 10:00 PDT for now. I'll send a calendar invite once Karthik confirms.

Also, Maya, quick heads-up: if NexaHealth will require SOC2 evidence or an IP allowlist for the hosted environment, please share the checklist and the right contact (our compliance team will pre-check before the call).

-on a separate note- I see there is a question about function/tool calling safety. We can bring a short checklist for safe tool invocation patterns and recommended rate limits.

Thanks — Marissa
Senior Account Executive | Redwood Inference
marissa_cole@redwood.com

Thanks Karthik and Marissa — Tue 9/14 10:00 PDT works for our team. Confirming the 60-minute slot.

I've attached a small example flow (pseudo data) and a short network diagram — please treat as internal. We'll join via the calendar invite; our engineering director (David Lin) may join for the first 15 minutes.

One quick note: we actually route outbound calls through a corporate egress proxy and require outbound TLS intercepts be disclosed to vendors. I'll add that in the pre-call doc so we can discuss if any network adjustments are needed.

See you tomorrow.

Best,
Maya
